items.title: Eddie Metz Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, October 3, 2015
items.q: So I did this whole new rock & roll record with them.

ctx.x: Yeah, Blues Image is one surviving member, Mike Pinera, who wrote that song. So I did this whole new rock & roll record with them. He also was part of Iron Butterfly when they did “In-A-Gadda-Da-Vida.”
